name: Gallagher's Traditional Pub
description: Historic military-themed pub from the 1820s with a barber shop inside. Irish-owned establishment known for traditional atmosphere and real ale.

name: Bow-Legged Beagle
description: Award-winning micro pub celebrating locally produced cask and craft ale. First opened on New Brighton's Victoria Road, now with multiple locations across Merseyside.

name: The Coop
description: Old school pub on College Road with Canadian maple flooring, low lighting and a welcoming bookcase. Opened October 2023 and quickly became a local favourite.

name: Beer Station
description: Compact pub near Freshfield station on Victoria Road in Formby. Known for quality real ale selection in an intimate setting.

name: The Philharmonic Dining Rooms
description: Historic Victorian pub in Liverpool's city centre, known for its ornate interior and classic real ale selection.

name: The White Star Pub
description: Traditional pub with nautical heritage, serving quality real ales and local beers in a welcoming atmosphere.

name: The Athenaeum
description: Grade II listed Georgian building housing a distinctive pub with character and an excellent selection of real ales.

name: The Grapes
description: Waterfront pub with views and a selection of quality real ales. Popular meeting spot for locals and visitors alike.

name: The Gate Inn
description: Community pub off the beaten track, offering genuine local hospitality and a fine selection of real ales.

name: The Beehive
description: Traditional community pub serving the Bebington area with quality real ales and a warm welcome.
